metadata.description: Android video-server p50/p95 throughput/latency baseline (#4758). Values mirror the QualityPreset.MEDIUM operating point (720p @ 4 Mbps @ 60fps) plus a hosted-runner buffer, and are PROVISIONAL targets pending several accumulated device-lane runs — the same posture the iOS aggregator (#4387) took by not committing a number until samples calibrated it. Ratchet down toward observed p50/p95 once the device lane has accumulated samples.
